mapper.sql: select purchase_order.id, purchase_order.code, purchase_order.order_date, purchase_order.supplier_id, purchase_order.supplier_name, purchase_order.purchaser, purchase_order.total_amount, purchase_order.status, purchase_order.void_reason, purchase_order.void_by, purchase_order.void_time, purchase_order.create_by, purchase_order.create_time, purchase_order.update_by, purchase_order.update_time, purchase_order.remark, (select count(1) from purchase_item pi where pi.purchase_id = purchase_order.id) as batchCount, (select coalesce(sum(pi.quantity), 0) from purchase_item pi where pi.purchase_id = purchase_order.id) as purchasedQty, (select coalesce(sum(d.num), 0) from t_sale_order_detail d join t_sale_order o on o.id = d.order_id where o.delivery_date = purchase_order.order_date and o.status >= 1 and o.is_deleted = 0 and d.is_deleted = 0) as requiredQty from purchase_order
mapper.select: where purchase_order.order_date = #{orderDate} and purchase_order.status != 3 order by purchase_order.id desc limit 1

code, order_date, supplier_id, supplier_name, purchaser, total_amount, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
